title: Restaurant Mad & Kaffe Aarhus is looking for kitchen workers
description:
Chef for Mad & Kaffe Aarhus

This October, Mad & Kaffe is opening its first café in Aarhus, and we're looking for passionate and ambitious Chefs to help build our kitchen from day one.

This is more than just another kitchen job. It's an opportunity to become part of the opening team, help shape the kitchen culture, and create memorable food experiences for our guests from the very beginning.

At Mad & Kaffe, we believe great food starts with great craftsmanship. We work with fresh, seasonal ingredients, prepare everything in-house, and take pride in delivering consistently high-quality dishes in a busy, fast-paced kitchen where teamwork is essential.

About the role

As a Chef at Mad & Kaffe, you'll play an important role in the daily operation of the kitchen. Working closely with the Head Chef and Sous Chef, you'll help ensure smooth service, maintain our high culinary standards, and contribute to a positive and professional kitchen culture.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Preparing and serving high-quality dishes during service

  • Ensuring consistency and attention to detail in every plate

  • Assisting with daily preparation and mise en place

  • Maintaining a clean, organized, and efficient kitchen

  • Working closely with the team to deliver exceptional guest experiences

  • Contributing to a positive, supportive, and professional working environment

About you

You're passionate about food and enjoy working in a professional kitchen where quality, teamwork, and continuous improvement are valued.

We imagine that you:

  • Have experience from a similar role in a professional kitchen

  • Are confident working independently while being a strong team player

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay calm under pressure

  • Take pride in delivering high-quality food every day

  • Have a strong work ethic and attention to detail

  • Are flexible with working hours, including evenings and weekends

  • Bring positive energy, commitment, and reliability to the team

What we offer

Joining Mad & Kaffe Aarhus means becoming part of something new from the very beginning.

We offer:

  • The opportunity to help build a brand-new kitchen and team

  • A workplace with trust, responsibility, and room to grow

  • A kitchen focused on fresh ingredients, quality, and craftsmanship

  • A dynamic working environment where no two days are the same

  • Professional and personal development opportunities within a growing company

  • A supportive and social team culture

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Staff benefits at all Mad & Kaffe cafés

  • A full-time position with long-term career opportunities

Apply

If you'd like to help shape the future of Mad & Kaffe Aarhus and be part of our opening team, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your motivated application to Head Chef David Andersen.

title: GENOPSLAG : Pædagog på 37 timer til Troldegården i Sulsted
description:
Om stillingen/arbejdspladsen:

GENOPSLAG 

37 timers Pædagog til fast stilling i Børnehaven Troldegården i Sulsted - med start 1. oktober 2026 eller senere 

Dagtilbud Nordvest består af 14 institutioner. Dagtilbuddet indeholder forskellige institutionsformer: børnehaver, integrerede institutioner, en specialgruppe og 4 specialbørnehaver, der er omfattet af Lov om Social Service.

Børnehaven Troldegården er normeret til 30 børnehavebørn, med 4 ansatte og en pædagogisk leder. Vi indgår i et forpligtende samarbejde med 10 andre institutioner i Dagtilbud Nordvest og har fællespasning i sommerferien, samt i julen og ved helligdage.

Troldegården består af 2 børnehavegrupper og er organiseret med blandede alder på de to grupper og 2 personaler på hver. Vi arbejder både stueopdelt og på tværs af huset.

Om stillingen
Vi søger dig, der:

 

 

 

  • Har mod på og erfaring med opgaver som forældresamtaler, handleplaner, sprogtest, dokumentation mm.
  • Gerne har kendskab til ICDP og/eller NEST – eller har lyst til at arbejde med det.
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med praksisnære læreplaner og være med til at sætte dit præg på hverdagen i Troldegården
  • Er hjertevarm, glad, imødekommende, smilende og anerkendende – og ja humor er jo altid godt have, det kan gøre hverdagen til en fest
  • Da vi er en lille personalegruppe, er det vigtigt at du kan være mødestabil, fleksibel, omstillingsparat og er god til at justerer læringsmiljøet, alt efter hvad dagen kalder på i børnegruppen og i personalegruppen

I Troldegården brænder vi for mange forskellige aktiviteter, og vi er åbne for dine kompetencer og interesser – hvad enten det drejer sig om musik, natur, kreative aktiviteter, bevægelse eller noget helt andet.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Deler vores børnesyn: “Børn gør altid det bedste, hvis de kan”.
  • Tager medansvar for positive relationer og gode interaktioner mellem børn og voksne.
  • Understøtter børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse i stærke børnefællesskaber.
  • Kan skabe struktur, tryghed og genkendelighed i hverdagen.
  • Ser forældresamarbejdet som en vigtig del af opgaven.
  • Har blik for børneinddragelse og arbejder aktivt med barnets stemme.
  • Kan arbejde indenfor åbningstiden kl. 06.15–16.55 samt deltage i aftenmøder.

 

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • Indflydelse på og medansvar for udviklingen af Troldegården.
  • Et fagligt stærkt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø.
  • En arbejdsplads med høj grad af medarbejderinddragelse.
  • Muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med pædagogiske læringsmiljøer og børnefællesskaber.
  • Muligheder for at bringe dine egne kompetencer i spil.
  • Medansvar for planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af børnegruppens udvikling og trivsel på tværs af hele børnegruppen

Hos os får du ikke kun dygtige og engagerede kolleger – du bliver også en del af et fællesskab, hvor vores arbejdsgang og kultur præges af at være tæt på i samarbejdet – med kollegaer, forældre og børn i Troldegården

 Vi tror på, at gode relationer skaber arbejdsglæde og styrker samarbejdet.

Børnenes ønsker til dig:

  • Du vil lege og være med os ude på legepladsen – også i regnvejr
  • Du vil trøste, hvis nogen slår sig og give os plaster på

.    Du kan grine og have det sjovt

  • Du hjælper, når vi har brug for det – altså når vi ikke kan det selv

.    Du kan give gode krammere

  • Du vil passe godt på os.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, hvor du forholder dig til ovenstående, samt beskriver hvordan børn, forældre og personale vil kunne se og mærke dig, hvis du bliver en del af vores fællesskab. 

For nærmere information om stillingen kan pædagogisk leder Helle Hedegaard Johansen kontaktes Tlf: 99 823240

Ansøgningsfristen er d.10 september og vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler onsdag d 16 september 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Forud for ansættelse indhenter vi reference og straffe- og børneattest.


Arbejdsstedets adresse

Troldelunden 2-4 

9381 Sulsted



Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.
Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Salgsprofil med drive søges til Jørgen Hansen Biler i Esbjerg
description:
Har du de hurtige sko på, tager du initiativ og sætter du kundens behov først? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Jørgen Hansen Biler søger vi en energisk og målrettet kollega til vores salgsafdeling i Esbjerg. Du bliver en del af et ungt team, hvor der er højt til loftet, godt humør og fart over feltet. I Esbjerg arbejder vi med Kia og MG, og du får derfor mulighed for at arbejde med to stærke bilmærker i en branche, hvor udviklingen går stærkt – ikke mindst inden for elektrificering og ny teknologi.

Vi leder efter dig, der har drive, tager initiativ og har lyst til at lære. Dig, der får ting til at ske, følger op på dine kunder og ikke er bange for at tage fat. Som en del af salgsteamet bliver du en vigtig del af hele kunderejsen – fra den første henvendelse til bilen bliver afleveret til kunden.

Arbejdstiden ligger både på hverdage og i weekender, da vores kunder også skal kunne møde os, når de har fri. Du skal derfor være indstillet på weekendvagter som en naturlig del af jobbet.

Din hverdag kommer blandt andet til at bestå af:

  • Assistere sælgere med praktiske opgaver

  • Praktiske opgaver i udstillingen og opsætning af udstilling, herunder at sørge for, at priser, lister og skilte er opdateret

  • Sikre, at demobiler er klar til prøvekørsel

  • Sidemandsoplæring

  • Kundekontakt i butikken, på telefon og digitalt

  • Rådgivning af kunder om deres næste bil

  • Opfølgning på kundehenvendelser og leads

  • Annoncering og præsentation af biler online

  • Oprettelse og opdatering i vores salgs- og CRM-systemer

  • Opfølgning på aftaler og igangværende salg

Vi arbejder struktureret med salget, men der er samtidig plads til, at du kan sætte dit eget præg på hverdagen.

title: SALGSSPECIALIST TIL ENTREPRENØRMASKINER – JYLLAND & FYN
description:
Kan du åbne nye døre, skabe relationen og lukke salget?

På vegne af Dansk Maskincenter A/S søger SelectioPlus en erfaren og resultatorienteret salgsspecialist, der skal være med til at udvikle Dansk Maskincenters salg inden for entreprenørsegmentet i Jylland og på Fyn – med Develon som en central del af sortimentet.

Dansk Maskincenter har et bredt sortiment af maskiner og løsninger til markedet. Develon er det senest tilkomne brand inden for entreprenørmaskiner og udgør en central del af ambitionen om at styrke virksomhedens position i entreprenørsegmentet.

Derfor leder vi ikke efter en sælger, der primært skal passe en eksisterende kundeportefølje. Vi søger en hunterprofil, som kender entreprenørbranchen, forstår markedet og motiveres af at opsøge nye kunder, skabe muligheder og omsætte dem til konkrete handler.

Du får stor frihed til at drive dit marked – og samtidig meget tydelige forventninger til resultaterne.

OPGAVEN

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe vækst i Dansk Maskincenters salg inden for entreprenørsegmentet – med Develon som en central del af sortimentet.

Du skal aktivt ud i markedet og opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder i Jylland og på Fyn. Det kræver, at du trives med den opsøgende del af salget og selv tager initiativ til at finde de næste muligheder.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

·       opsøge og udvikle nye kunder

·       sælge entreprenørmaskiner fra Dansk Maskincenters sortiment til nye og eksisterende kunder

·       identificere nye salgsmuligheder i markedet

·       følge mulighederne hele vejen fra første kontakt til afsluttet handel

·       rådgive kunderne og finde den rigtige løsning til deres behov

·       sikre høj aktivitet og en stærk pipeline

·       deltage på relevante messer, kundearrangementer og møder

·       bidrage praktisk, når det er nødvendigt – her hjælper man hinanden

Det afgørende er ikke, at du er den mest administrative sælger i branchen. Det afgørende er, at du kan skabe salg og afslutte handler.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du allerede kender entreprenørbranchen og har erfaring med salg i markedet.

Du har minimum tre års salgserfaring – gerne fem år eller mere – og du ved, hvad der skal til for at skabe en kundeportefølje og holde momentum i et salgsområde.

Din konkrete uddannelsesbaggrund er mindre vigtig. Erfaring, branchekendskab og dokumenterede salgsresultater vejer tungere.

Som person er du udadvendt og kontaktskabende. Du får energi af at være ude hos kunderne og er ikke afhængig af, at leads og muligheder kommer til dig.

Du er selvkørende, resultatorienteret og vedholdende. Og når muligheden er der, har du både lysten og evnen til at bede om ordren og få handlen afsluttet.

Samtidig skal du være ordentlig. Dansk Maskincenter ønsker langsigtede kunderelationer, så resultater skal skabes med troværdighed, empati og respekt for kunden.

Du taler og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

DER ER KLARE FORVENTNINGER

Du kommer ind i en stilling, hvor succes kan måles.

Efter de første tre måneder er ambitionen, at du har opbygget en reel pipeline med omkring 24 tilbud og har solgt de første tre maskiner.

Efter seks måneder er målet omkring otte solgte maskiner.

Efter 12 måneder er ambitionen et salg på cirka 15 mio. kr., samtidig med at det brugte lager løbende bliver omsat.

Tallene fortæller noget vigtigt om stillingen: Det her er en salgsrolle.

Du bliver ansat til at skabe aktivitet, nye kunder og resultater – og du får samtidig friheden til selv at finde vejen derhen.

STOR FRIHED I HVERDAGEN

Salgsområdet er Jylland og Fyn, og derfor er det oplagt, at du bor et sted i dette område.

Du behøver ikke bo tæt på Dansk Maskincenters hovedkontor. Du får mulighed for at have kontor på en af virksomhedens lokationer og kan også arbejde hjemmefra.

Du tilrettelægger i høj grad selv din hverdag og dine kundebesøg. Den normale arbejdstid ligger omkring kl. 8.00-16.00, men jobbet kræver naturligvis fleksibilitet i forbindelse med messer, kundemøder og andre relevante aktiviteter.

DU BLIVER EN DEL AF DANSK MASKINCENTER

Dansk Maskincenter A/S er en moderne maskinforretning med afdelinger i Jelling, Odder, Rimmerhus og Toftlund og omkring 87 engagerede medarbejdere.

Virksomheden sælger blandt andet traktorer, høstmaskiner, redskaber, plæneklippere, mindre maskiner og Develon entreprenørmaskiner. På alle lokationer understøttes kunderne desuden af reservedelssalg og egne værksteder.

Det giver dig en organisation i ryggen, som kan understøtte både salget og kunderne efter handlen.

Kulturen er flad og uformel med højt til loftet, god energi og humor. Der er frihed under ansvar – men også forventning om, at du tager ejerskab for dit område og dine resultater.

VI TILBYDER

Du tilbydes en fast fuldtidsstilling med en månedlig grundløn, afhængigt af kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Herudover tilbydes pension, sundhedsforsikring, fri telefon og firmabil.

Der er ikke bonusordning knyttet til stillingen. Til gengæld får du stor selvstændighed og mulighed for at få en central rolle i udviklingen af Dansk Maskincenters forretning inden for entreprenørsegmentet.

Tiltrædelse ønskes hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

INTERESSERET?

Rekrutteringen gennemføres af SelectioPlus på vegne af Dansk Maskincenter A/S.

Send dit CV og gerne en kort motivation til:

Henrik Sødequist
Headhunter & Managing Partner, SelectioPlus
hs@selectioplus.dk

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater løbende og afslutter processen, når det rette match er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du også meget velkommen til at kontakte Henrik Sødequist.

SELECTIOPLUS – People. Purpose. Precision.

title: Strategic Marketing Specialist / Business Analyst
description:
The Role:

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded professional who can translate customer and market insights into growth opportunities. Working across functions, you will help drive innovation, strategic prioritization, and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

The Strategic Marketing Specialist supports the execution of the division’s growth strategy by translating customer insights and market dynamics into actionable inputs for strategic decision-making. Working under the Head of Strategic Marketing, the role contributes to Customer Back Innovation (CBI) initiatives and helps identify high-value opportunities across segments and applications.

In close collaboration with Product Management, Sales, and Engineering, the position ensures alignment between market needs and solution development, supporting 80/20-focused prioritization and differentiated value creation.

The role plays a key part in strengthening ITW GSE’s ability to make informed, insight-driven decisions and deliver customer-focused, innovative solutions to the aviation industry.

Position Requirements:

  • Master's Degree in Engineering and/or Business, preferably with a focus on strategy, innovation, or commercial development

  • Strong analytical skills, and ability to boil down complexity into key points and make strategic decisions

  • Preferably industry knowledge and insight into key trends and market development

  • Strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills

  • Global experience with deep cultural understanding and a proven ability to navigate complex multicultural environments and drive alignment across regions

  • Fluent in English with the ability to communicate effectively in Danish. Additional language skills are considered an advantage

  • Experience with CRM systems and their development potential, including leading cross-functional implementation initiatives and driving global adoption

About ITW:

Founded in 1912, Illinois Tool Works Inc. (ITW) is a Fortune 300 global multi-industry manufacturing leader with revenue of $16 billion in 2025. The company’s seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW’s approximately 43,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company’s decentralized and entrepreneurial culture.

ITW GSE is one of the 80+ divisions in ITW under the Specialty Segment with manufacturing facilities and sales offices in Odense, Denmark, and Palmetto, Florida, and sales offices in Dubai and Singapore. ITW GSE is the leading supplier of ground power equipment, pre-conditioned air and accessories to the aviation industry with a revenue of $213 million (2025) and 220 dedicated colleagues.

title: Fuldtid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person? - Genopslag
description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Da vi skal starte nye ejendomme op i og omkring Ålborg, så søger vi et team af nye viceværter. Vi forventer at vi skal bruge 1 på fuldtid og 2 på deltid.

Denne her stilling er fuldtid, med mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du i din ansøgning oplyser, at den stilling du søger er fuldtid.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?
Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?
Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne
•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme
•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn
•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene
•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning
•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaver

Det med småt

Bil: Da stilling er fuldtid, stiller vi en firmabil til rådighed.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

Du skal forvente at løse opgaver primært i og omkring Ålborg og Nørresundby. Da vi har kunder i hele Midtjylland, kan der også være behov for at hjælpe kolleger i nogle af de andre midtjyske byer. 

Opstart: Vi søger en profil til opstart i løbet af september, så vi er klar til at vi overtager pasningen af ejendommene til d. 1 oktober. Arbejdstiden i september kan dog være varierende.

Vi holder samtalerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at tage fat i os allerede i dag.

Vil du med?
Lyder det som noget for dig, så send dit CV til andreas@dalboege.com. Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive med eventuelle spørgsmål eller læse mere om os på dalbøgesejendomsservice.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

title: Operating Partner & General Manager (Profit Sharing & Equity)
description:
Operating Partner & General Manager – RAY'S Chicken

We run RAY'S Chicken at Hejrevej in Nordvest, sharing a roof and a taproom with Gamma Brewing. We take a lot of pride in what we do: 24-hour buttermilk marinades, custom spice rubs, homemade sauces, and fried chicken that stands out in Copenhagen.

We are ready to build RAY'S into a multi-location brand. To do that, we need a partner on the ground to take over the daily operation of our flagship location, dial in our systems, and build the foundation for our next openings.

This role comes with base pay, direct profit sharing, and an equity track.

What the Job Looks Like

You will start on the floor. To run and expand this business, you need to understand every moving part firsthand.

  • Step 1: Learn the Shop You'll spend your first weeks working the line—prepping chicken, running the fryers, packing orders, handling Wolt and takeaway rushes, and talking to guests.

  • Step 2: Take Full Ownership of Hejrevej Once you know the rhythm of the place, you take the reins of day-to-day operations: scheduling the crew, ordering from suppliers, keeping food costs tight, staying on top of Fødevarestyrelsen hygiene standards, and making sure the food quality never slips.

  • Step 3: Build for Expansion You'll help turn our daily workflows into clear, repeatable routines so that training new staff is easy. When we are ready to open location number two, you will be deeply involved in site setup, hiring, and launch.

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need years of high-end restaurant experience. If you have run a busy kitchen or managed a bar, great. But if your background is in retail, small business, logistics, or running physical projects and you love fast-paced, hands-on work, we want to hear from you.

Here is what actually matters to us:

  • High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs fixing. If a station is dirty, an order is delayed, or inventory is running low, you jump in and solve it.

  • Comfortable on Your Feet:  You enjoy the energy of a packed Friday night shift and you lead your team by working alongside them.

  • Organized & Practical: You notice small details. You can build simple checklists, manage inventory without wasting stock, and keep a kitchen running cleanly under pressure.

  • Good with People: You stay calm and constructive when the ticket machine is going non-stop and the room is full. You treat your team with respect and set a solid pace.

  • Long-Term Mindset: You want to build something real and share in the financial upside through profit distribution and equity as the business grows.

The Deal

  • Compensation: Base salary after experience with a road map to profit sharing.

  • Equity Pathway: Clear, milestone-based equity vesting as you take full operational ownership and we expand.

  • Direct Access: You work directly alongside the founders. No bureaucracy, no corporate politics—good ideas get tested and put into action immediately.

  • Great Location: A vibrant base at Hejrevej 6B in Nordvest, working alongside the Gamma Brewing team.

How to Apply

Send us your CV along with a short email telling us:

  1. What you have built, managed, or fixed in previous jobs.

  2. Why running and scaling a food business at this stage makes sense for you.

  • Email: work@diamondslice.dk

  • Subject: Rays Partner

title: Lærer søges til Egeskolens "små hold"
description:
Lærer søges til Egeskolens "små hold"

Vi søger vi en ny kompetent kollega til vores gruppeordning på Egeskolen. 

Er du en relationsstærk lærer, der kan navigere i et bredt fagligt spænd? 

Har du lyst til at skabe individuelle veje mod voksenlivet for vores elever i 9. og 10. klasse? Så er det dig, vi mangler på Egeskolen i Furesø.

 På Egeskolen søger vi en dedikeret lærer på fuld tid til vores gruppeordning. Her bliver du en del af et team, der brænder for at skabe de bedste fremtidige muligheder for de unge.

Om arbejdet med vores elever

Vores elevgruppe i 9. og 10. klasse er kendetegnet ved at være meget forskelligartede. Du skal trives med en hverdag, hvor der ikke findes ”one size fits all”.

Vi har elever, der arbejder målrettet mod de fulde afgangsprøver (FP9/FP10), og elever, der har brug for et mere tilpasset forløb med fokus på mestring og livsduelighed.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af differentieret undervisning i Engelsk

  • Udvikling af individuelle projekter i samarbejde med teamet og eleven.

  • Støtte eleverne i deres praktikforløb og samarbejde med interne, såvel som eksterne partnere.

  • Tæt kontaktlærerfunktion med fokus på både faglighed og trivsel.

  • Fokus på et udvidet forældresamarbejde og ser forældrene som en vigtig ressource i arbejdet omkring eleven.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter en kollega, der kan varetage undervisning og prøveafvikling i engelsk og ser det som en spændende udfordring, at to dage aldrig er ens.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet lærer og har erfaring med eller stor lyst til specialområdet.

  • Kan se muligheder i det enkelte barn og tør tænke ud af boksen, når den traditionelle undervisning ikke rækker. 

  • Trives med et tæt og forpligtende kollegialt samarbejde.

  • Har mod på det tværfaglige samarbejde med forældre, UU-vejledere og praktiksteder.

  • Besidder en god portion tålmodighed og en anerkendende tilgang.

Hvorfor vælge os?

På Egeskolen vægter vi det professionelle fællesskab højt. Vi løfter i flok, deler vores erfaringer og støtter hinanden. Hos os bliver du en del af et trygt og anerkendende arbejdsmiljø med fokus på trivsel og respekt. Du får samtidig stor frihed og et godt skema med mulighed for at gøre en forskel.

Herudover tilbyder vi fast supervision med vores interne psykolog. 

Praktisk info

  • Ansættelsesforhold: Fuld tid.

  • Arbejdssted: Egeskolen, Furesø Kommune.

  • Ansøgningsfrist: mandag 21.9 2026

  • Ansættelsessamtaler forventes onsdag 23.9

  • Tiltrædelse: 1.11.2026

Vil du høre mere?
Kontakt gerne koordinator Stina Dybdahl 7216 5325 eller skoleleder Leif Petersen 72164330 for at høre mere om stillingen eller aftale et besøg.

 

Praktisk

Der indhentes referencer fra tidligere ansættelsesforhold, hvis du kommer i betragtning til stillingen.

I Furesø Kommune sker løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og ud fra principperne i Ny Løn.

 

Job i Furesø? Kom og vær med!
I Furesø skaber vi løsninger sammen. Med kolleger på tværs af organisationen. Med brugere og borgere – ja med alle, vi er kommune for.
Fællesskaberne er vores svar på de udfordringer, vores velfærdssamfund står foran i de kommende år, hvor flere får brug for velfærdsydelser og over længere tid. Og hvor nye ideer derfor skal forny den service, vi yder.

Derfor giver vi plads til mødet mellem fagene og mellem mennesker, for det er her, innovationen opstår. Vi koordinerer med hinanden på tværs af titler og fagligheder, og vi holder godt styr på den daglige drift for at skabe sammenhæng for vores borgere. Vores hverdag har fokus på nærvær fremfor fravær på en sund arbejdsplads med røgfri arbejdstid. Så kom og vær med. Vi har også plads til dig.

title: Socialrådgiver med miljøterapeutiske kompetencer
description:
Arresødal Slot søger en socialrådgiver til blandede vagter med hver tredje weekend i en 37 timers stilling.

 
Brænder du for socialpsykiatri og psykosocialrehabilitering? Trives du med udfordringer og krav om høj faglighed? Bidrager du aktivt til det gode arbejdsmiljø, fællesskabet og sparring til dine kollegaer i hverdagen? Vil du være med til at præge et  moderne bo- og behandlingssted. Så kan det være dig, der er en af vores nye medarbejder på bo- og behandlingstilbuddet Arresødal Slot.

 Kort fortalt
Arresødal Slot er et bo- og behandlingssted for mennesker med psykisk sårbarhed med plads til 21 beboere fra 18 – 65 år. 

Arresødal Slot danner rammerne for et meningsfyldt og værdigt liv.   

Vi tror på, at vores beboere kan komme sig helt eller delvist. Det er afgørende, at der er klare mål med indsatsen, og at Arresødal Slots metoder medvirker til at støtte beboeren i at mestre eget liv. 

 Vi respekterer og sikrer beboernes medinddragelse og indflydelse på beslutninger om sig selv og om hverdagen på Arresødal Slot.  Vi sikrer udvikling for beboerne ud fra deres ønsker, muligheder og individuelle handleplan. 

Hverdagen på Arresødal Slot er fyldt med aktivitet og fællesskab. Det er med til at danne grobund for fremtidige sociale netværk og en sund livsstil. Fællesskabet er desuden med til at skabe positive, sociale relationer til det omgivende samfund. 


Alle beboerne har psykiatriske problemstillinger og diagnoser, det kan være i form af skizofreni, angstlidelser, personligheds forstyrrelser, OCD, Autisme og mindre udviklings forstyrrelser som ADD og ADHD. Flere af beboerne kan have svært ved at begå sig i sociale sammenhænge og har en tendens til at isolere sig. Beboerne kan have behov for støtte, for ikke at komme ud i et misbrug af et eller flere rusmidler. Der er ingen tolerance for aktivt misbrug på Arresødal Slot.
Beboerne har egen bolig, og benytter de dejlige faciliteter og fællesarealer i mange sociale sammenhænge. Vi vægter kreativitet, fysisk aktivitet, alsidig og sund kost samt udbud af beskæftigelse og undervisningstilbud. 

Arresødal Slot er en del af en non-profit organisation, Ok-fonden.
 
Om jobbet
Vi fokuserer på en helhedsorienteret og koordineret indsats og forventer, at du evner at bidrage med høj faglighed, engagement og god energi. Dine opgaver vil være at indgå i teamet som skal støtte beboerne, samt sikre den daglige målrettede indsats/behandling og indgå i det tværfaglige samarbejde. Derudover vil der være timer afsat ugentligt, til at lave socialrådgiver opgave, og sparre med kollegaer om disse.

Vi forventer, at du:

   • Er uddannet socialrådgiver, gerne med særlige kompetencer inden for det psykiatriske felt.
   • Har et fagligt ambitionsniveau, er selvstændig, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde på tværs af fagligheder.
   • Har kendskab/erfaring med systemisk teori og praksis er et ønske, men ikke et krav.

   Vi tilbyder: 
    •Et job fuld af dynamik med mulighed for fortsat personlig og faglig udvikling
   • En spændende og alsidig hverdag
   • Supervision
   • En personalestab med plads til humor

Yderligere oplysninger
Stillingen ønskes besat snarest eller 1 december 2026 .

Stillingen søges elektronisk senest d. 25/9- 2026 kl. 12.00.
Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler uge 41 2026

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger ved henvendelse til Chef Le Cenius på telefon 23 42 04 43 eller Souschef Knud Erik Pedersen på telefon 30 10 71 70

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

Who we are
AAU Energy is an research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges. 

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems. 

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues. 

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.  

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support  

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as assistant professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level. The research potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. 
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish). 

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish). 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Assistant, Tenure-Track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Software Engineering and Software Technology
description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invite applications for one or more positions within software engineering and software technology. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the software engineering and software technology research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI for Software Engineering and Software Engineering for AI

  • Software Architecture and Design, including Architecting for AI Systems and AI-assisted Architecting

  • LLM-based, Agentic, and Multi-agent Software Systems

  • Human-AI collaboration in Software Development

  • Software Engineering for Physical AI and Embodied Systems

  • Self-Adaptive and Autonomous Software Systems

  • AI Orchestration and Infrastructure for AI Compute Offloading

  • Software Engineering for Embedded, Cyber-Physical and IoT-Edge-Cloud Systems

  • Governance, Compliance and Accountability of AI-Enabled Software

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Software Operation, Evolution, Maintenance, Recovery and Modernization

  • Software Reliability Engineering

  • Empirical Software Engineering

  • Requirements Engineering, Specification, and Modelling

 

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship. 

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as ICSE, FSE, ASE, ICSA, ECSA, MLSys, DATE, RE, SEAMS, ICSME, SANER, MODELS, ESEM, ICPE and CAiSE, EICS; and in journals such as TSE, TOSEM, EMSE, JSS, IST and IEEE Software.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam (Associate Professor): mtmo@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Steel Fitters Wanted
description:
Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

title: Elternzeitvertretung/barselsvikar für/til Kulturvereinbarung/Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig (Kulturmanager/in)
description:
Elternzeitvertretung für die Kulturvereinbarung Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Möchten Sie Kulturaktivitäten mit entwickeln und umsetzen, die Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene über die deutsch-dänische Grenze hinweg zusammenbringen?

Ein vielseitiger deutsch-dänischer Arbeitsplatz sucht eine engagierte Projektmitarbeiterin bzw. einen engagierten Projektmitarbeiter für eine Elternzeitvertretung ab dem 1. November 2026. Ihre Aufgaben liegen überwiegend im Bereich der Aktivitäten der Kulturvereinbarung Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Die Kulturvereinbarung wurde zwischen dem Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, dem Kreis Nordfriesland, der Stadt Flensburg, der Haderslev Kommune, der Aabenraa Kommune, der Tønder Kommune, der Sønderborg Kommune, der Region Syddanmark und dem Land Schleswig-Holstein geschlossen.

Die Umsetzung der Kulturvereinbarung wird durch eine Förderung des dänischen Kulturministeriums unterstützt. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Stärkung kultureller Gemeinschaften und des Wohlbefindens, die Förderung von Demokratie und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe in der Grenzregion sowie die Unterstützung von Begegnungen und Kooperationen über die Grenze hinweg.

Sie werden beim Regionskontor & Infocenter angestellt und Teil des Teams für Kultur, Sprache und bürgernahe Aktivitäten. Durch Ihre unterschiedlichen Aufgaben arbeiten Sie eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen auf beiden Seiten der Grenze, Kulturschaffenden, Schulen, Kindergärten und weiteren Kooperationspartnern zusammen.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

•  Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines deutsch-dänischen Kindertheaterstücks

•  Planung und Durchführung eines Projekts für Schülerinnen und Schüler zu den Herausforderungen des Klimawandels und Möglichkeiten des Klimaschutzes aus der Perspektive von Kindern

•  Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung deutsch-dänischer Demokratiecamps und Demokratiesalons

•  Planung und Koordination deutsch-dänischer Begegnungen und Erfahrungsaustausche

•  Kommunikation und Vermittlung der Aktivitäten der Kulturvereinbarung

•  Unterstützung bei den weiteren Aufgaben des Teams im abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag.

Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Sie:

•  über eine relevante Ausbildung bzw. einen relevanten Studienabschluss verfügen

•  sowohl Dänisch als auch Deutsch so gut beherrschen, dass Sie sich mündlich und schriftlich sicher und problemlos in beiden Sprachen verständigen können

•  Erfahrung mit der grenzüberschreitenden Zusammenarbeit haben oder sich dafür interessieren

•  auf Netzwerke im Kultur- und Freizeitbereich in Dänemark und Deutschland zurückgreifen

können

•  Erfahrung in der Projektarbeit haben und effizient und strukturiert arbeiten

•  gerne in interdisziplinären Teams arbeiten und aktiv dazu beitragen, Lösungen zu finden, wenn Plan A nicht funktioniert.

Es wird erwartet, dass Sie Ihre Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten können, da auch Abend- und Wochenendtermine stattfinden. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir bieten:

•  eine spannende und eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit mit konkreten Projektaktivitäten

•  die Möglichkeit, sich mit Themen wie Lebensqualität, Gemeinschaft, Demokratie und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe in einem deutsch-dänischen Kontext zu beschäftigen

•  eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kulturverwaltungen und Kulturschaffenden auf beiden Seiten der Grenze

•  flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Montag und Dienstag sind feste Präsenztage.

Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich am Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, 6330 Padborg, etwa 10 km von der Grenze entfernt. Sie sollten jedoch damit rechnen, an Sitzungen und Aktivitäten in der gesamten Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig teilzunehmen.

Vergütung und Beschäftigungsbedingungen

Es handelt sich um eine Elternzeitvertretung vom 1. November 2026 bis voraussichtlich zum 31.Oktober 2027 mit einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 26 Stunden. Die Beschäftigung steht unterdem Vorbehalt möglicher Änderungen des Budgets.

Die Vergütung und Beschäftigungsbedingungen richten sich nach dem geltenden Tarifvertrag.

Bewerbungsgespräche

Bewerbungsfrist: 17. September 2026

Bewerbungsgespräche: 23. September 2026

Arbeitsbeginn: 1. November 2026

Leiter Peter Hansen, +45 74 67 05 01

oder

Barselsvikar til Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Vil du være med til at udvikle og gennemføre kulturaktiviteter, der bringer børn, unge og voksne sammen på tværs af den dansk-tyske grænse?En alsidig dansk-tysk arbejdsplads søger en engageret projektmedarbejder til et barselsvikariat fra den 1. november 2026. Dine opgaver vil fortrinsvis være aktiviteter under Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Kulturaftalen er indgået mellem Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, Kreis Nordfriesland, Stadt Flensburg, Haderslev Kommune, Aabenraa Kommune, Tønder Kommune, Sønderborg Kommune, Region Syddanmark og delstaten Schleswig-Holstein. Kulturaftalen gennemføres med et tilskud fra det danske kulturministerium. Fokus er på at styrke kulturelle fællesskaber og trivsel, fremme demokrati og medborgerskab i grænselandet samt understøtte møder og samarbejder på tværs af grænsen.

Du bliver ansat på Regionskontor & Infocenter og bliver en del af teamet for kultur, sprog og borgernære aktiviteter. Gennem de forskellige opgaver kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med kollegaer fra begge sider af grænsen, kulturaktører, skoler, børnehaver og andre samarbejdspartnere.

Jobbet vil bl.a. omfatte:

•  At være med til at udvikle og gennemføre en dansk-tysk børneteaterforestilling

•  At stå for et projekt for elever om klimaudfordringer og klimahandling i børnehøjde

•  At være med til at gennemføre dansk-tyske demokraticamps og demokratisaloner

•  At planlægge og koordinere dansk-tyske møder og erfaringsudveksling

•  At formidle kulturaftalens aktiviteter

•  At bidrage til teamets øvrige opgaver og være en hjælpende hånd for kollegaerne i en travl hverdag.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

•  har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund

•  behersker både dansk og tysk så godt, at du mundtligt og skriftligt ubesværet kan kommunikere på begge sprog

•  har erfaring med eller interesse for det grænseoverskridende samarbejde

•  kan trække på netværk inden for kultur- og fritidsområdet i både Danmark og Tyskland

•  har erfaring med projektarbejde og arbejder effektivt og struktureret

•  trives i tværfaglige teams og bidrager aktivt til at finde løsninger, når plan A ikke lykkes.

Det forventes, at du kan tilrettelægge din arbejdstid fleksibelt, da der både vil være aften- og weekendmøder. Det forudsættes, at du har kørekort til personbil.

Vi tilbyder:

•  et spændende og selvstændigt job med konkrete projektaktiviteter

•  mulighed for at arbejde med emner som livskvalitet, fællesskaber, demokrati og medborgerskab i en dansk-tysk kontekst

•  tæt samarbejde med kulturforvaltninger og -aktører på begge sider af grænsen

•  fleksibel arbejdstid og muligheder for hjemmearbejde. Mandag og tirsdag er faste fremmødedage.

Du får arbejdsplads på Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, 6330 Padborg ca. 10 km. fra grænsen, men du kan forvente at skulle til møder og aktiviteter i hele Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Der er tale om et barselsvikariat fra den 1. november 2026 til forventeligt den 31. oktober 2027 på 26 timer ugentligt. Ansættelsen er med forbehold for eventuelle budgetændringer. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.
