title: Project & Business Coordinator
description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

  • Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

If you have any questions, please contact Patrick Frømming, Manager, Infrastructure & Security (PFN@nordic-rcc.net).

title: Assistant Professors and/or Associate Professors in Clinical and Preventive Odontology
description:
Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark is seeking two motivated individuals for two fixed-term appointments (2 years, up to 37 hours per week, with the possibility of extension). The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Inspector, Private Home Cleaning  - Copenhagen
description:
RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for a dedicated inspector for our private home cleaning department

Do you have an eye for detail, and do you thrive in a role where quality and great customer relations go hand in hand? Then you might be our new inspector.

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024. We provide cleaning for housing associations, businesses and private customers across Greater Copenhagen – and it is our private customers you will be working with.

About the job

As inspector in our private cleaning department, you will be the link between our customers and our cleaning teams. You will report to the company's owner and managing director and play a central role in making sure quality is spot on every single time.

Your main tasks will be:

•      Quality control – ongoing inspection of completed cleaning in our private customers' homes

•      Quality reports – documentation and follow-up on inspection visits

•      Customer contact and relations – dialogue with customers, handling requests and feedback, and building long-term customer relationships

•      Operational support – hands-on support for the daily operations of the private cleaning department

Other tasks within the scope and responsibility of the position may also occur.

We expect that you

•      Have experience from the cleaning industry, the service industry or a similar role with quality responsibility

•      Have a sharp eye for detail and high standards for quality

•      Are outgoing and service-minded and enjoy daily customer contact

•      Communicate confidently in Danish, both spoken and written, including for reporting

•      Work in a structured and independent way and can plan your own day

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as the working day involves driving between customers

Experience with quality control or inspection work is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

•      A full-time position of 40 hours per week with a fixed monthly salary

•      Employment as a salaried employee (funktionær) under proper terms – any overtime is compensated with time off in lieu at a 1:1 ratio

•      Health insurance paid by the company

•      A company car for work use by agreement, and work clothing where the position requires it

•      An informal and busy working day in a growing company with short decision-making paths

•      Green values in practice: Nordic Swan Ecolabel certification and an electric vehicle fleet

Practical information

•      Workplace: Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup – with daily driving to customers across Greater Copenhagen

•      Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday between 8:00 and 17:00 (Friday until 16:30)

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior RF Systems & Hardware Engineer – Coherent RF Architecture
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems & Hardware Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.


Contact:

For recruitment related questions contact Human Resources Director, AislinnCampbell, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

title: DSP Engineer - RF Sensing & Geolocation
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Digital Signal Processing Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will predominantly involve designing and implementing DSP algorithms for signal classification, interference detection, signal deinterleaving, and geo-localisation within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, and product teams, with your primary focus being to develop and validate DSP algorithms that improve sensing performance, robustness, and product quality across defense use cases.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, validate, and mature DSP algorithms that improve the performance, robustness, and quality of Quadsat’s RF sensing and geolocation capabilities.

  • Design, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms for RF signal classification, interference detection, demodulation, signal analysis, and geo-localization within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.
  • Develop algorithm concepts, reference implementations, and validation tools in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Work with recorded and live RF data to evaluate algorithm performance, identify limitations, and improve robustness under real-world conditions such as noise, interference, multipath, calibration errors, and synchronization effects.
  • Contribute to direction finding and RF sensing capabilities, including methods such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, tracking, and related estimation techniques.
  • Define test methods, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms, including accuracy, sensitivity, stability, robustness, and failure modes.
  • Collaborate with software, embedded, FPGA, and RF engineers to support the transition of validated algorithms into product-ready implementations.
  • Provide technical leadership within DSP and RF sensing, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s algorithm development, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in DSP development for RF, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, or other advanced sensing systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience developing and validating DSP algorithms on real RF data.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with digital signal processing for RF and Software Defined Radio systems.
  • Proven ability to develop, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Experience working with real RF measurement data, including noisy or imperfect data from SDRs, radar, EW, SATCOM, telecom, or related systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF signal chains, including sampling, bandwidth, filtering, SNR, synchronization, phase, and calibration effects.
  • Experience with signal detection, classification, interference analysis, signal characterization, or geolocation-related signal processing.
  • Experience with direction finding or RF sensing techniques such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, triangulation, tracking, or related estimation methods.
  • Ability to define validation methods, performance metrics, test cases, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms.
  • Familiarity with SDR platforms and practical deployment constraints such as real-time processing, data throughput, latency, synchronization, and hardware limitations.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, robotics, and product teams.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar development, SIGINT, RF surveillance, coherent multi-channel RF systems, C/C++ implementation, FPGA-based DSP, embedded DSP, fixed-point processing, CUDA, VHDL, Verilog, calibration, or transitioning algorithms from prototype into operational products.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. description:
Are you an experienced structural or marine engineer who knows how to turn complex vessel or larger steel structure designs into safe, buildable solutions? This is a rare opportunity to take technical ownership of structural construction for modern naval vessels and help strengthen the future of the Danish naval industry.

Your position
Join Semco Maritime as Senior Structural Lead and take a central role in the construction of modern naval vessels for the Royal Danish Navy. Working at the interface between engineering, procurement, planning, suppliers, and shipyard production, you will translate structural designs and class requirements into practical construction strategies that support safe and efficient execution.

As the senior technical focal point for structural construction, you will influence key decisions from design maturity and production engineering through fabrication, assembly, and delivery. You will coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces, anticipate constructability and schedule risks, and help ensure that structural work is completed to the required quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

This is a visible, hands-on leadership role with close proximity to production and real influence on how the vessels are built. Your primary workplace will be in Frederikshavn or alternatively Esbjerg. The position is full-time, permanent, and occasional travel may be required.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As the Senior Structural Lead for structural construction, you will lead and coordinate the structural construction activities throughout the naval vessel production lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Defining and planning the structural construction route from design to production.
  • Leading the production engineering process and providing technical support to procurement.
  • Serving as the technical point of contact for structural construction matters across departments and with suppliers.
  • Managing resources, supervising assembly, and ensuring adherence to quality, schedule, and HSE standards.
  • Supporting production planning to develop efficient and buildable solutions.

Your profile & qualifications
We are seeking a proactive and technically adept engineer who excels in a multidisciplinary environment and has a passion for shipbuilding and naval defence.

Ideal qualifications:
  • BSc or MSc in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in shipbuilding / ship construction. Alternative could be experience from large scale off-shore construction and / or infrastructure sites or process facilities. 
  • Familiarity with international classification rules (e.g., DNV, ABS); knowledge of naval or defence standards is highly beneficial.
  • Proficient in interpreting technical drawings and 3D models.
  • Fluency in English is required; Danish language skills are a significant advantage.
  • You should have a structured, quality-focused approach with excellent coordination and communication skills.
  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Able to obtain a FE security clearance

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the planet. By joining us, you will become part of a community of over 2,300 dedicated thinkers and doers who drive meaningful change and leave their mark on the world. 

We provide the answers needed to make change real, believing that ambitious goals can only be achieved through hard work and innovative, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a better future.

So yes, working for us will spark change – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

title: PhD Position in 3D Concrete Printing for Low-Carbon Buildings
description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a more sustainable built environment to apply for a PhD position in 3D Concrete Printing for Low-Carbon Buildings. The position is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 23:59 CET/CEST.

 

Scope of the work

The PhD position is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. The overall ambition is to develop a new generation of low-carbon prefabricated building systems enabled by 3D concrete printing, rethinking how concrete structures are designed, fabricated, and assembled.

The research will bring together architectural design, structural optimisation, and artificial intelligence to generate materially efficient building systems in which geometry, structural performance, and fabrication are developed as an integrated whole. It will address advanced toolpath generation, reinforcement integration, structural connections, and assembly through unified computational design and robotic fabrication workflows.

The candidate will develop artificial intelligence-driven pipelines connecting structural evaluation, geometry generation, fabrication planning, and robotic production. The work will combine computational research with extensive laboratory experimentation, including the robotic printing of full-scale components and building demonstrators at SDU CREATE and their validation through structural testing.

The candidate will also contribute to teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through laboratory teaching, workshops, and co-supervision of student projects.

 

Focus Area and Research Project

The research focuses on developing the next generation of low-carbon building systems. 3D concrete printing offers significant opportunities for prefabrication, geometric differentiation, and project-specific optimisation. Realising this potential requires an integrated approach in which architectural design, structural performance, robotic fabrication, reinforcement, connections, and assembly are addressed as interdependent aspects of a building system.

The project will develop computational and experimental methods for the design, fabrication, and validation of materially efficient prefabricated building systems. It will extend SDU CREATE’s research on performance-informed architectural design, structural optimisation, hybrid printing, reinforcement integration, and full-scale robotic construction.

The research will address the following areas:

  • Computational design of architecturally and structurally integrated prefabricated building systems for 3DCP

  • Structural optimisation at component and system levels, encompassing slabs, beams, columns, walls, nodes, and their connections

  • Artificial intelligence-driven pipelines connecting geometry generation, structural evaluation, and fabrication planning

  • Advanced toolpath generation and sensing-based process control for structurally differentiated components

  • Integration of reinforcement, structural connections, fabrication constraints, and assembly requirements into robotic production workflows

  • Robotic 3D printing of full-scale components and construction of integrated building demonstrators

  • Structural testing of printed components, connections, and assembled systems

  • Quantitative evaluation of material consumption, embodied carbon, structural performance, and production efficiency

 

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, with a focus on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation.  SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable and regenerative approaches to the design and production of the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, concrete mixing and extrusion equipment, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full-scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads the research field on Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to the research field on Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

 

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication and structural testing experiments, including direct operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

The candidate’s engagement in these activities will evolve with their growing experience, contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally toward future career advancement.

 

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, civil or architectural engineering, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Documented interest and foundational knowledge in the research area of 3D Concrete Printing

  • Advanced competence in Grasshopper and Rhino. Knowledge of Python, C#, or finite element analysis is evaluated positively

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document, and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Experience with hands-on and experimental lab and construction activities 

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams, coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written, and oral formats

  • Beneficial experience in teaching assistance or peer-reviewed publications

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects

  • Engagement with academic or industry stakeholders in relevant domains

 

Contact Information

For further information about this position and SDU CREATE's activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk. For additional information on the Centre´s work, visit the website at www.create-sdu.com. If you encounter technical issues during the application process, please contact our email support.

 

Application Procedure

Applicants are advised to carefully read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and 

how to apply for academic staff before submitting their application. The application must be submitted in English and include the following documents, uploaded in the specified order as PDF files:

  1. Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. The form is available on the Faculty website.

  2. Motivation letter and research statement, with a maximum combined length of five pages. The document should clearly describe the applicant’s proposed research direction and qualifications for the position.

  3. Detailed curriculum vitae, including academic and professional experience, research projects, teaching and supervision experience, awards, exhibitions, and computational and fabrication skills.

  4. List of publications, if applicable, including copies of publications the applicant wishes the committee to assess.

  5. Verified copies of official bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and academic transcripts, provided in Danish or accompanied by an official English translation. Applicants currently enrolled in a master’s programme must include a statement indicating their expected completion date.

  6. Completed TEK PhD form for calculating grade point average.

  7. Official documentation describing the educational structure and grading system of the awarding institution, if the degree was obtained outside Denmark.

  8. Portfolio of up to 15 pages presenting selected research, teaching, or professional projects.

  9. Contact details for at least two referees, including their names and email addresses. The referees may be contacted during the selection process.

 The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

Assessment and Selection process
Read about the Assessment and selection process. An expert will assess applications. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation process.

 

Enrollment and Employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

title: Digital Content & Creative Lead
description:
Paiblock is a Fintech company that provides secure access to emerging asset classes to qualified investors, and global crypto payment processing solutions to e-commerce

We are looking for a Content & Creative Lead to join our Copenhagen team. In this role, you will take ownership of our visual content production and bring it to life across our site and channels. You will be responsible for our visual look and feel - setting direction for Paiblock and defining how content shows up everywhere our customers meet us.

This is a role for someone who combines a strong marketing understanding with hands-on content execution. You'll own visual content across our website and channels - the standard, the quality, and making sure we set and keep direction. Using the newest AI tools, you'll produce great content at scale while building automated creative workflows.

The position is full-time and based at Paiblock’s Copenhagen Office in Denmark, where you'll be part of a fast-paced, ambitious environment with a strong commercial focus. You'll also have people responsibility, managing subcontractors who support content production.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Content & Creative Production Manager, you will own content production end-to-end - from setting creative direction to getting content live. You’ll take part in defining the visual bar for Paiblock and make sure everything we launch reflects it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking ownership of overall content production and getting content live across our site and channels - email, socials, creative ads, etc.

  • Using the newest AI tools to execute and produce content at scale

  • Owning the delivery of content packages for new products

  • Setting visual and direction for Paiblock

  • Defining how we use our content on our site

  • Building and setting up automated creative workflows

  • Managing and coordinating subcontractors who support content production

  • Pushing our site and channels to the next level in look and feel

  • And so much more

The Ideal Profile

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-driven and knows all about the newest AI content production tools, with a background in content, creative, or marketing roles, preferably within blockchain or digital lifestyle company.

We imagine that you:

  • Have a strong sense of visual direction, and what good looks like

  • Have a marketing understanding

  • Have strongly adopted AI and use the newest tools to execute and produce content

  • Know how to set up automated creative workflows to scale content production

  • Have experience setting visual direction and look and feel across channels

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken

You are someone who:

  • Is motivated by ownership and accountability

  • Is ambitious, takes initiative and turns opportunities into clear, structured actions. And executes them.

  • Is creative and obsessive about quality and detail

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

  • Enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong internal relationships

What We Offer

Our people are at the core of our success, and we work in an environment that values ownership, development, and collaboration - where your contributions make a real impact.

  • A full-time, on-site position at our Copenhagen office in Denmark

  • A role with ownership of our content production and visual direction, with direct impact on how Paiblock shows up everywhere

  • Strong opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A social, dynamic, and ambitious workplace culture

  • Hands-on responsibility for setting the creative bar and producing content with the newest AI tools

  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues

  • A modern, data- and tech-driven workplace where AI and new tools are actively applied

title: Farmimehaanik
description:
Otsime oma meeskonda farmimehaanikut, kes aitaks hoida töös meie suure piimafarmi tehnika ja seadmed.

Tööülesanded: Oleme edukas ja arenev põllumajandusettevõte, kus väärtustame kaasaegseid lahendusi, tugevat meeskonda ja inimesi, kes tahavad oma tööga päriselt midagi ära teha.
Farmis on ligikaudu 1000 looma, mistõttu on tehniliste süsteemide sujuv toimimine meie igapäevatöös väga olulisel kohal. See on hea võimalus inimesele, kes soovib teha praktilist ja mitmekesist tööd ning olla osa ettevõttest, mis areneb, investeerib ja kasvab. Sinu tööks saab olema: - farmi masinate ja seadmete hooldus ning remont; - lüpsi- ja muude farmiseadmete rikete tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine; - tehnosüsteemide korrasoleku jälgimine; - ennetavate hooldustööde tegemine; - erinevate tehniliste probleemide lahendamine; - koostöö farmi meeskonna ja teiste tehnikutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Olla osa professionaalsest ja toetavast meeskonnast;
- teha mitmekesist tööd kaasaegses piimafarmis; - arendada oma tehnilisi teadmisi ja oskusi; - töötada erinevate seadmete ja tehnosüsteemidega; - kaasa rääkida ja oma teadmistega ettevõtte arengusse panustada; - kindlat ja pikaajalist töökohta; - töötasu suurus sõltub oskustest ning panusest; - vajalikud töövahendid ja tööriided; - ametiauto.

Muud nõuded: Meie ootused:
Sul on hea tehniline taip ja praktiline mõtlemine; oskad või soovid õppida masinaid ja seadmeid remontima; oled iseseisev, kohusetundlik ja lahendustele orienteeritud; hindad vaheldusrikast tööd ja soovid oma töö tulemust päriselt näha. Varasem kogemus piimafarmis ei ole tingimata vajalik. Olulisem on huvi tehnika vastu, õppimisvõime ja soov areneda.
